method.links: Q&A -> article links are the VLOnto 0.1.0 KG edges_qa_article (34,869 rows, 22,523 Q&As), rebuilt from the source datasets with the pipeline's clean, chunk, fix_docnums and eval_retrieval gold stages (v1 labels, as used by the KG).
method.areas: The 27 hdpl areas; id = hdpl category slug; Vietnamese label from hdpl 'area'; English label from VLOnto's legal-area scheme (vlonto config AREA_LABELS).
method.ranking: Per area, articles ranked by the number of distinct answers in the area that cite them; ties: more answers overall, then the newer law (issue date), then article id. Top 20 per area.
method.representative: One answer per article from the same area: titles without person names first, then answers that quote the article word for word (match >= 0.5), then answers not already used for a higher-ranked article, then the most recent published date.
method.match: Word 5-gram containment of the cited provision's text in the answer text (paper, Section 4 and Table 6): share of the provision's 5-grams found in the answer. Provision = the most specific cited unit found in the parsed article (point > clause > article). verified = match >= 0.5. match_4gram is given for reference.
method.trace: Question, answer, every provision the answer cites that resolves to a parsed article (point -> clause -> article -> section -> chapter -> work), documents cited as a whole (work), the vbpl record of the ranked article's law, up to 3 tnpl terms named in the question title or text with the clause or point that defines them in the laws of the trace (pattern 'X là ...', match = tnpl definition 5-grams in that unit), the area, and up to 20 other answers in the same area that cite the same law (up to 3 on the ranked article, then one per article in turn). At most 60 nodes unless the answer's own sources need more.
method.highlight: on_trace = on a verified path or on the primary path (the answer's citation of the ranked article). verified = on a verified path (drawn as the paper's dark navy path with golden halo). On 'cites' links of other answers, verified = that answer's citation matches >= 0.5.
method.labels: Điều N / Art. N; Khoản K Điều N / Art. N(K); Điểm P khoản K Điều N / Art. N(K)(P); Chương / Chapter; Mục / Section; codes and laws as '<name> <year>', other documents as '<type> <number>'. English law names from the vbpl English records (normalised), else machine-assisted; English question glosses are machine-assisted (<= 15 words).
method.licence: No answer text, no article, clause or point text, no person names. Question titles are shown for the traced questions (user decision 2026-11-12); other answers carry their title only when it is at most 70 characters and free of person names. refs are citations as written in the answer (<= 160 characters).
method.format: Booleans on_trace and verified are present only when true; url only when known. Node ids follow the KG: <doc>::dieu-N[::khoan-K][::diem-P], <doc>::chuong-x[/muc-y]; q:/a:/oq:<hdpl id>, term:<tnpl id>, wk:<document number>, vbpl:<doc id>, area:<slug>. provenance.dataset: hdpl, vbpl or tnpl (see source_revisions).
